parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: The edition of the instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: ConnectionMode
parameters.description: The access mode of the instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: ConnectionString
parameters.description: The endpoint of the instance. You can use this endpoint to query the corresponding instance.

parameters.name: DBInstanceClass
parameters.description: The instance type. For more information, see [Instance types](~~26312~~).

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID.

parameters.name: DBInstanceStatus
parameters.description: The instance status. For more information, see [Instance states](~~26315~~).

parameters.name: DBInstanceType
parameters.description: The instance type. Valid values:

parameters.name: DedicatedHostGroupId
parameters.description: The dedicated cluster ID.

parameters.name: DedicatedHostId
parameters.description: The host ID in the dedicated cluster.

parameters.name: Engine
parameters.description:
The database engine. Valid values:
* **MySQL**
* **SQLServer**
* **PostgreSQL**
* **MariaDB**

By default, instances of all database engine types are returned.

parameters.name: EngineVersion
parameters.description: The database engine version.

parameters.name: Expired
parameters.description: The expiration status of the instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The JSON string that contains the instance filter conditions and their values.

parameters.name: InstanceLevel
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return the instance edition (Category) information. Valid values:

parameters.name: InstanceNetworkType
parameters.description: The network type of the instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1 to 100**.

Default value: **30**.
>If you specify this parameter, the **PageSize** and **PageNumber** parameters are not available.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of **NextToken** that is returned from the last call to the **DescribeDBInstances** operation. If the results span multiple pages, you can use this token to retrieve the next page.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1** to **100**.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description: The billing method. Valid values:

parameters.name: QueryAutoRenewal
parameters.description: A reserved parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to query the available regions.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID.

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The keyword that is used for fuzzy search by instance ID or instance description.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tags that are bound to the instance. Each tag consists of a TagKey and a TagValue. You can specify up to 5 tags in a single request. Format: {"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"...}. If the instance matches any of the specified tags, the instance information is returned.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: VPC ID。

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID.

parameters.name: proxyId
parameters.description: A deprecated parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter.
